CAR LOGOS — Arts LMU OVERLAY 0.7

Manufacturer logos are used only to identify cars in the local racing overlay.
Names and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners.
Arts LMU OVERLAY is an independent personal application, not affiliated with
or endorsed by Le Mans Ultimate or any of the manufacturers shown.

Porsche, Ferrari, BMW, Mercedes, Aston Martin, McLaren, Ford, Chevrolet,
Toyota, Peugeot, Lamborghini and Cadillac icon vectors:
Simple Icons v11.15.0, https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/11.15.0/icons
CC0-1.0 dedication for the icon collection: see SimpleIcons-CC0.txt.
The collection's dedication does not grant trademark rights.
Vectors were rasterized in a compact, brand-colored palette for a recognizable
colored display in the dark, small overlay. The original SVGs remain alongside
the PNGs for traceability; the palette is an overlay treatment, not a claim
that every manufacturer mark has only one official color.

Alpine and Lexus raster logo files, unchanged:
https://github.com/filippofilip95/car-logos-dataset
logos/optimized/alpine.png and logos/optimized/lexus.png (retrieved 2026-09-13).
Underlying marks and artwork remain owned by their respective manufacturers;
no open-source license or endorsement for these two marks is asserted here.

The personal Arts logo was supplied by the user and remains unchanged.
The steering-wheel drawing has no Porsche badge.
